name: hashu
description: Hashu heater: sells a home miner's hashrate as THH vouchers, switching its pool through MDK while a redemption is filled.

routes.description: Heaters, their pool and heat level and why, open THH redemptions, sats earned per kWh of heat, and the event log.
Set the thermostat (setpointC, maxRoomC, enabled) and per-heater overrides (auto, home, hashu, off).
Demo only: open a THH redemption on the Hashu proxy (stands in for a Cashu melt).
